#  44406 - Design and Optimization of Process Plants II Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **44406 - module is no longer offered from WS 2012/13**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Design and Optimization of Process Plants II**  |  
|  Auslegung und Optimierung prozesstechnischer Anlagen II   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 4 - Environmental Sciences and Process Engineering   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr.-Ing. Witt, Werner 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every winter semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Introduction in advanced plant design and – operation technologies; Process plant optimization based on dynamic simulation  |  
| Contents:  | Basics: Simulation of process plants (with Aspen Plus, Chemcad), design errors, CAE-Information technology, control- and automation, start-up procedure, Optimization: Strategy/methods for optimization of process plants, optimization with e.g. AspenPlus and dynamic simulation with e.g. AspenDynamics, case studies   |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Strongly recommended: Fundamentals of mathematics, physics (thermodynamics, heat- and mass-transfer), process plant design   |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 3 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 3 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 90 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | a) Lecture notes b) Power point, CAE software(ComosPt), simulation software (AspenPlus, Aspen Dynamics, Chemcad) via Intranet / Internetc) Literature: see lecture notes   |  
| Module Examination:  | Unspecified - Specification from winter semester 2016/17 required!  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | Participation at exercises and practical simulation training (min. 70%), exercise and practical training reports, written examination 90 min.   |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | no  |  
| Module Components:  | None  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
